booking_request.script: For NEW inbound callers wanting to book: 'Certainly. I'll help arrange the next step...' (Note: Do not ask for their city if you already know it from an outbound form.)

ready_to_decide.script: Certainly. I'll take your details and have our team arrange the next step for you. We'll keep the process straightforward from here.

private_booking.guidance: For High-Profile Clients Who Need Discretion:
private_booking.script: Certainly. For clients who value discretion, we can arrange a more private consultation experience. The journey should feel comfortable, confidential and unhurried.

cta_soft.script: If you'd like, I can help you find the appropriate Authorized Smile Designer for your city.

cta_medium.script: The natural next step would be a Smile Discovery Consultation, where your goals and options can be properly understood.

cta_strong.script: For inbound callers ready to proceed: 'Certainly. I'll note your details and our team can arrange the consultation from there.' (Warning: Never ask for name/city if already known.)

existing_booking_inquiry.guidance: When an outbound caller asks about their existing booking:
existing_booking_inquiry.script: Your booking request is already registered with our partner clinic in your city, and our team will contact you shortly to confirm the details.
